issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the Developer experience-description method: the problem statement and the template expect an instance method named `swiftExperienceDescription()` (see problem_statement.md and template Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift), but the solution implementation defines the method as `getExperienceDescription()` in Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift while the solution's Client (Sources/DeveloperLib/Client.swift) still calls `swiftExperienceDescription()`. This mismatch means the solution as provided will not compile (Client calls a method that does not exist on Developer) and will confuse students about which method name they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Two valid fixes: (A) Rename the solution's `getExperienceDescription()` to `swiftExperienceDescription()` and update all internal calls in the solution (e.g., the initializer) to call `swiftExperienceDescription()`, or (B) change the problem statement, template, and Client to require and call `getExperienceDescription()` instead. Preferred approach: rename the solution method to `swiftExperienceDescription()` so the solution matches the problem statement and template, and ensure Client calls that same name.
